content: वृथा {%ind.%} [वृ-थाल् किच्च] .²1 To no purpose, in vain, uselessly, unprofitably; often with the force of an adjective; व्यर्थ यत्र कपीन्द्रसख्यमपि मे वीर्य हरीणां वृथा <ls>U. 3. 45</ls>; दिवं यदि प्रार्थयसे वृथा श्रमः <ls>Ku. 5. 45</ls>. .²2 Unnecessarily. .²3 Foolishly, idly, wantonly. .²4 Wrongly; improperly. (At the beginning of <ab>comp.</ab> वृथा may be translated by ‘vain, useless, improper, false, idle’ <ab>&c.</ab>).
